data_fields.name: bubble draw groups per frame
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 (normal, target, attack), each drawn only if present

best_idea: Build every label on the frame into one shared glyph list, upload it once and draw it once per group (text, then at most three bubble types), and hold each label's pixel position inside a hysteresis band so text does not shimmer.
decision_why: The one-batch-per-group shape and the hysteresis pixel lock transfer; the Unity buffer and draw calls do not. Labels in Frankendom are only for the local player, the target, hover and the three attackers, so the draw count is bounded by design; the donor's distance-based physics discovery should become a client read of engine state.
acceptance: On a 375 px phone with the local player, one target and three attackers on screen, the label layer submits at most four draw calls (one per non-empty group), and a label standing still does not move more than 1 px between frames.
